title: Hello BadCode Picks
eyebrow: Hello, I'm BadCode · voice and movement · round 3
heading: Who BadCode sounds like, and how he moves
intro: Finishing the whole thing (your call: cut 2b's real opening won so far). Rough cut 3 is on its own timeline page with voice a and clip b. Here: pick BadCode's voice (each take reads the four lines of draft 1D, your line third), and how he moves in the launderette. Your earlier rounds are folded below.

sections.lede: Voices from AI Studio, four different people; clips animated on the tab pool (2 minutes for all three). The mask holds in all three, checked zoomed in.

groups.title: BadCode's voice
groups.line: Pick one. A note like 'older' or 'less posh' makes the next round.

opts.label: a: calm, polite, southern English, far-future (the temp voice)
b: Yorkshire man in his sixties, gravelly, unimpressed
c: south London, late twenties, flat and bored
d: Glasgow woman in her fifties, warm and wry

groups.title: How BadCode moves
groups.line: Pick one. The same clip, pushed in closer, is used after the reel for your line.

opts.label: a: still and patient, the room moves around him
b: leans in toward you, hands together
c: a small polite wave
